items.headline: Three CJEU preliminary rulings on air quality: ClientEarth (C-404/13), Craeynest (C-723/17) and Deutsche Umwelthilfe v Freistaat Bayern (C-752/18)
France: three judgments on State liability for air pollution (Tribunal administratif de Montreuil 2019, Cour administrative d’appel de Paris 2024, Cour administrative d’appel de Lyon 2025)
Czechia joins the database: three Ostrava cases on air quality plans and compensation
Poland: final outcome of the Rybnik smog case, the Warsaw smog case and Trybunał Konstytucyjny judgment SK 23/17
Italian Supreme Court of Cassation, Joint Civil Divisions, judgment no. 28087/2026 of 29 October 2026: suspension of the hot area of the former Ilva steelworks in Taranto confirmed
